d.ko: Build and run your own waterpark solo or with friends. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!
d.en: Build and run your own waterpark solo or with friends. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!
d.zh: 建造并经营属于你的水上乐园。设计滑水道，在布偶物理的加持下让游客漫天飞舞，管理员工，并全面自定义你的乐园。进入这款第一人称经营模拟游戏，在一片混乱中打造出五星级帝国吧！
